# provisions-cluster

Declares that an object in this cluster reconciles into another cluster.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| resourceKind | string | *(required)* | Fully qualified kind of the object that represents the cluster. Required.  Qualified because the planner hands it to `kubectl`, and a bare kind is ambiguous the moment two API groups define one.  |
| resourceName | string | *(required)* | Name of that object. Required.  A floe rendering the object from this declaration would use the same name, which is the point of there being one declaration.  |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| provisioning | [CLUSTER_PROVISIONING](../signatures/CLUSTER_PROVISIONING.md) | An object in another cluster that reconciles into this one. |
